notes: UI polish: gauges, a live temperature graph, and a status orb
patch_notes: UI polish pass: CPU and GPU cards gain gauge bars that fill and change color with the heat, a status orb in the sidebar shows the state at a glance (grey for no source, green calm, cyan in a session, pulsing red over the line), a new live graph card draws the last minutes of CPU/GPU temperatures with the CPU warning line dashed in, the session card's border turns red while the CPU is over the line, and every history row gets a severity dot colored by its peak. Two new test rounds (14 helpers, 15 GUI polish); all 15 rounds pass.
